name: nested-vaul-drawer

frames.best_why: The third nested sheet is open on top of the others with its own title and button visible.

tagline: Bottom sheets that stack on top of each other as you go deeper.
summary: A black stage with a single Open Drawer button. Clicking it raises a dark bottom sheet with a drag handle, a title and text, and buttons inside open further sheets layered on top, each dismissed by swiping or tapping away.
appearance: Idle, just a small white rounded button on black. Opened, a charcoal sheet rises from the bottom with a short grab handle, a bold title, two or three grey paragraphs and a full-width pale button. A nested sheet covers most of it, repeating the handle, title, copy and button.
behaviour: Clicking the button slides a sheet up over a dimmed backdrop with a springy settle. The inner buttons push new sheets up on top of the previous ones, and dragging the handle down or tapping the backdrop closes them in order.
demo_content: Sheets titled "Drawer for React." and "This drawer is nested." with developer notes and GitHub links.
search_phrases: bottom sheet that stacks another sheet
drawer that opens from the bottom
use_when: A mobile or tablet flow needs layers of detail shown as stacked bottom sheets with swipe to close.
avoid_when: The sheets assume a dark page, and the copy talks about the drawer's own code rather than real content.
customise: The titles, notes, footer links and three nested levels are hardcoded inside the drawers; colours come from theme tokens.
weight_why: Three static sheets with spring transitions; nothing runs until a drawer is opened.

a11y.note: The dialog library traps focus and closes on Escape, but the spring sheet motion has no reduced-motion guard.

issues: At rest the component is only a lone button, so the drawer is invisible until clicked.
Two nested sheets carry the same title, "This drawer is nested.", so levels are hard to tell apart.
The sheet copy describes the drawer's own implementation instead of sample content.
polish_why: Tidy stacked sheets; the plain charcoal panels and developer copy read as a docs demo.
title: Nested Vaul Drawer
